```{=html}
<script>
    document.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        const yearToggle = event.target.closest(".pub-year-toggle");
        if (yearToggle) {
            const targetId = yearToggle.getAttribute("aria-controls");
            const content = targetId ? document.getElementById(targetId) : null;
            if (!content) return;
            const isOpen = yearToggle.classList.contains("is-open");
            yearToggle.classList.toggle("is-open", !isOpen);
            yearToggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(!isOpen));
            content.hidden = isOpen;
            return;
        }

        const toggle = event.target.closest(".pub-toggle");
        if (toggle) {
            const card = toggle.closest(".pub-card");
            const targetId = toggle.getAttribute("aria-controls");
            const panel = card ? card.querySelector(`#${targetId}`) : null;
            if (!panel) return;
            const wasOpen = toggle.classList.contains("is-open");
            if (card) {
                card.querySelectorAll(".pub-toggle.is-open").forEach((button) => {
                    button.classList.remove("is-open");
                    button.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
                });
                card.querySelectorAll(".pub-panel.is-open").forEach((openPanel) => {
                    openPanel.classList.remove("is-open");
                    openPanel.hidden = true;
                });
            }
            if (!wasOpen) {
                toggle.classList.add("is-open");
                toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
                panel.classList.add("is-open");
                panel.hidden = false;
            }
            return;
        }

        const button = event.target.closest(".pub-bib-copy");
        if (!button) return;
        const wrapper = button.closest(".pub-bibtex-wrap");
        const pre = wrapper ? wrapper.querySelector(".pub-bibtex") : null;
        if (!pre) return;
        const text = pre.textContent || "";
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
            button.classList.add("is-copied");
            const originalLabel = button.getAttribute("aria-label") || "Copy BibTeX";
            button.setAttribute("aria-label", "Copied");
            window.setTimeout(() => {
                button.classList.remove("is-copied");
                button.setAttribute("aria-label", originalLabel);
            }, 1200);
        });
    });
</script>
```
